verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS feedback-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Canny's hosted service: an embedded widget, a JavaScript SDK, hosted integrations and a hosted MCP server. Nothing documents a deployable or on-premises version. The Business-plan staging workspace is another Canny-hosted instance, not self-hosting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
